title: Counterfort vs frozen Vanguard
intro: Outcome-labelled six-cell exhibition. Counterfort reads only visible or recently remembered battlefield facts; this is a behavior review, not a balance measurement.

cards.trigger: A carrier became visible while the enemy return corridor still had recent traffic.
cards.tactic: Four denial bodies collapse: Towline pull, Sunder mark, Hush suppression, then carrier-first focus.
cards.counterplay: Clear or bypass the return lane, bait the three signature cooldowns, and keep the carrier masked until an escort opens the corridor.
cards.fallback: Without both facts, the group resumes enemy-Well occupation, loose-Core work, recovery, and ordinary combat.
cards.watch: Counterfort response appears from t330 through t411.
